profit.reason: Hypothesis: small professional offices may value less routine administration; this notice establishes only human work, not AI-service demand.

candidates.reason: The bounded fictional follow-up/KPI draft is assessable, but its five ratings average 4.0 and no attached building reference supports its mechanics.
